plugin.name: omc-pstack-fy
plugin.description: pstack's engineering rigor inside oh-my-claudecode. A Claude Code build of pstack by Lauren Tan (poteto): oh-my-claudecode runs the project, pstack writes and reviews the code. if you want to go fast, go deep first.

imports.why: poteto-mode runs /deslop before every commit. Lauren ships it in cursor-team-kit, from the same upstream repository.
poteto-mode and several playbooks verify UI work with control-ui.
poteto-mode and several playbooks verify CLI and TUI work with control-cli.

exclude.why: Cursor-only. It wakes a Grok Bot through Cursor Automations webhooks, which Claude Code does not have.
